g.text: do / cumin sends the merge (also while cumin stops)
stop the implementation for the Owner
ask the Owner to decide the merge
request the cause from the Reviewer
stop the review for the Owner
request a response to the Owner's review
stop the merge for the Owner
: cumin starts an agent, and reads the quota usage first. At a limit, cumin starts nothing
and counts nothing; the issue keeps its state, and a later poll decides again.
: cumin starts an agent, and reads no usage: an issue in work goes on.
Gray: cumin starts no agent (a label, a comment, a notification, a close). Dashed: the Owner acts.
While cumin stops after the current runs (cumin stop --after-current-runs):
cumin takes no red and no blue transition; the issue keeps its state until the next start.
cumin still takes the gray transitions, and still sends a merge.
